question: Which triggers run on this object, and are they the same across orgs?

steps.name: triggers
steps.soql: SELECT Name, Status, ApiVersion, UsageBeforeInsert, UsageAfterInsert, UsageBeforeUpdate, UsageAfterUpdate, CreatedBy.Name, CreatedDate, LastModifiedBy.Name, LastModifiedDate, Body FROM ApexTrigger WHERE TableEnumOrId = '{obj}' ORDER BY Name

traps: Compare the Body hash, not LastModifiedDate, which can read stale after a deploy.
